spec:
OCTREG v1.1 — FINAL SPECIFICATION (synthesised from the "accuracy" design as base, with the grafts named by both judges; everything a judge called fatal is removed or fixed)

Repository: /Users/yyttim/workspace/lsfm-project/octreg locally, /root/autodl-tmp/oct-mri-registration on the AutoDL box (cwd for every command below; if the scripts live under octreg/scripts/ on the server, prefix accordingly). The tree is not under git: the main loop snapshots v1 as tag `v1` BEFORE implementers start; the DANDI regression is measured against a fresh run of that snapshot, not against the stale stored runs (HANDOFF trap 22).

======================================================================
0. PRINCIPLES (binding for every implementer)
======================================================================
P0.1 Zero-diff on cortex by construction: with all new flags at their defaults, prep_subject.py and register.py execute exactly the v1 call sequence (same functions, same order, same arithmetic). Every new behaviour is behind a flag or behind a data-driven rule that provably does not fire on DANDI (I46: V_int 0.72 vs V_mri 803 cm3; I55: 5.5 vs 621 cm3).
P0.2 Frozen files for everyone: octreg/common.py, refine.py, search.py, features.py, vascular.py, evaluate.py, nonrigid.py, parser.py, synth.py; scripts/fig_*.py, run_subject.sh, run_all.sh. The fp16 cap 60000 (common.py:204, a local) is re-declared as a constant CAP_F16 = 60000.0 in destripe.py.
P0.3 One sharp primary loss for the optimiser (sign-corrected, 3 mm-flattened masked NCC, P2's winner, contrast 0.54), independent measures used as VERIFIERS, never summed into a multi-channel loss (MIND-SSC contrast 0.02, NGF 0.09, |grad| biased 1.6 mm at 0.3 mm -> excluded). The fine stage uses a SINGLE channel; the [WM,GM] class channels (the representation the brief names as a root cause on the brainstem) are used only as a protection gate.
P0.4 The fine stage optimises a DELTA transform D about identity with the start pose folded into the loss (T = T_start @ D). This makes Refiner.refine's absolute ls/sh clamps and its reg*(|ls|^2+|sh|^2) term RELATIVE to the start pose without editing refine.py. Verified against refine.py: refine() calls only self.loss_of; clamps act on the optimised params; params_from_matrix(I) gives ls0 = sh0 = 0, mirror False. Without this, I46's depth stretch 1.219 (ls = 0.198 > 0.15) would be clipped on the first step.
P0.5 Every refinement stage that can move the pose (vascular, fine) has an acceptance gate; nothing is accepted unconditionally any more. A rejected stage returns the start pose and logs all numbers; that is normal behaviour, not an error.
P0.6 Zeros in OCT arrays are missing data (black tiles), never dark tissue: validity masks are derived from octv > 0 / oct150 > 0 with erosion and passed as weights; oct150 partial volumes go down to 0.002 so use pooled-validity > 0.99 at any level.
P0.7 Label-free verification (restart consistency, multi-similarity agreement, split-half, inverse consistency, 1-D landscapes incl. log-scale, boundary agreement, checkerboard/edge overlays) is the development criterion; the label-free uncertainty U is the paper number, labelled as self-consistency; DANDI labels are used ONLY for the regression check.

1.3 Specimen mask (octreg/specimen.py; P1 recipe (g), CPU, multiprocessing.Pool(4), OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 per worker; all sizes in mm converted with the octv voxel size; port of work/probe_xr/mask/scripts/{p1_aniso04,p1_rim04,p1_final,p1_common}.py):
  Step 1 texture field on the working grid W = octv pooled by kW = max(1, round(0.16 / vox_v)) (I58: 4 -> 0.16 mm): process octv in z-chunks of 128 (+16 pad): m = octv > 0; bs = G_sigma(octv*m) / max(G_sigma(m), 1e-3), sigma = 0.08 mm; for each array axis a: masked 1-D running std with window 0.36 mm (mu_a = U(bs*m)/U(m); s_a = sqrt(max(U(bs^2 m)/U(m) - mu_a^2, 0)); s_a = 0 where U(m) < 0.5); local mean MU = U9(bs*m)/U9(m) with a 3-D box of 0.36 mm; weighted mean-pool by kW of (s_z m, s_y m, s_x m, MU m, m); divide by pooled m; valid = pooled m > 0.5; masked Gaussian smoothing sigma 0.48 mm; F = min(s_z, s_y, s_x) / max(MU, 1); F = 0 outside valid.
  Step 2 thr = equal-weighted-density crossing between the two means of a 2-component 1-D Gaussian mixture on log F[valid & F>0] (numpy EM, 500k subsample, 100 iterations, init means at p25/p75, equal initial sd = std/2). NEVER Otsu/multi-Otsu on this field (they split at the rim class: 4.6 cm3). I58 expected thr ~ 0.0151, log-means -4.47/-3.75.
  Step 3 rim elevation E on W: per chunk, 3-D local std with window 0.20 mm after Gaussian sigma = 1 octv voxel; max-pool by kW; E = 0 outside valid.
  Step 4 markers: inner = binary_opening(F > thr, ball r = 0.64 mm); outer = binary_opening(F < thr, ball 0.64 mm) | ~valid; lab = skimage.segmentation.watershed(E, markers); specimen = (lab == inner) & valid.
  Step 5 exterior pockets: connected components of (lab == outer & valid) that touch no box face and no zero cell (1-cell dilation of ~valid) -> specimen.
  Step 6 cleanup: binary_closing with ball 0.48 mm on an edge-padded array (np.pad mode='edge', then crop; plain scipy binary_closing erodes cut faces), n_cc = number of components (recorded), keep the largest component (P1-validated; see open question 3), binary_fill_holes.
  Step 7 resample: mask_W as float -> scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates(order=1, mode='nearest') through inv(A_W) @ A150 onto the 0.15 grid, > 0.5, & (o150 > 0), largest CC, fill holes -> mask150_tex. octv-grid mask: same through inv(A_W) @ A_v in 64-slice chunks into an np.lib.format.open_memmap bool file (a.work/"octv_mask_texture.npy"), > 0.5 & (octv > 0).
  Function: oct_specimen_mask(octv: np.ndarray (f16/f32, Z,Y,X), A_v: np.ndarray 4x4, o150: np.ndarray f32, A150: np.ndarray 4x4, work: Path, n_workers: int = 4) -> (mask150_tex: np.ndarray bool, maskv_path: Path, info: dict{V_cm3_150, V_cm3_W, V_cm3_v, thr, gmm{log_means, sds, weights}, n_cc_before_largest, frac150, seconds_field, seconds_rim, seconds_ws}).

1.4 Destripe (octreg/destripe.py, owner C; P3's validated flat-field, 73 s on the full I58 octv). Signatures (A calls these; freeze before coding):
  detect_stripe_axis(vol: np.ndarray f16 (Z,Y,X), mask: np.ndarray bool | None = None, n_planes: int = 40, hp_sigma_vox: float = 3.0, ratio_max: float = 0.8) -> (axis: int | None, info: dict{ncc_median_per_axis: [3], ratio: float, period_vox: float | None, fft_peak_over_median: float})
    For each array axis: 40 evenly spaced adjacent-plane pairs (skipping the outer 5 %), each plane high-passed (plane - gaussian_filter(plane, hp_sigma_vox)), NCC over voxels where both planes are in the mask (or > 0 if mask None); median over pairs. axis = argmin if min < ratio_max * second-smallest, else None. period_vox: FFT peak of the per-plane mean profile along the chosen axis (planes' mean inside mask, detrended by a 60-plane running mean, Hann window), returned only if peak/median of the spectrum >= 3 (I58: 7.5 vox at 0.04 mm), else None. I58: NCC x 0.427 vs y 0.667 / z 0.645 -> axis 2, ratio 0.66.
  destripe_inplace(vol: np.ndarray f16 (Z,Y,X), axis: int, vox_mm: float, sigma_smooth_mm: float = 0.48, sigma_hp_mm: float = 0.24, cap: float = 60000.0, zchunk: int = 64, pad: int = 40, n_workers: int = 4, mask: np.ndarray bool | None = None, save_S: Path | None = None) -> info: dict{applied: True, axis, sigma_vox: [3], profile_resid_std_before: [3], profile_resid_std_after: [3], fft_peak_before, fft_peak_after, zero_fraction_before, zero_fraction_after, min_nonzero_after, max_after, seconds}
    Per chunk of zchunk slices along array axis 0 with pad slices each side (when axis == 0, chunk along array axis 1 instead): v = chunk float32; valid = v > 0; sig = sigma_smooth_mm / vox_mm on the two non-stripe axes, 0 along axis; A = G(sig)(v*valid) / G(sig)(valid); ok = denominator > 0.05; B = G(sigma_hp_mm / vox_mm along axis only)(A*ok) / G(same)(ok); S = where(ok, A - B, 0); v' = where(valid, clip(v - S, 1, cap), 0); write back the un-padded core as float16 in place. Additive only (multiplicative was not better). Zeros stay exactly 0; finite guaranteed by the clip. Profile statistics: per-plane mean inside `mask` (eroded 2 mm by the caller) along each axis, detrended by a 60-plane running mean, std; computed before and after (I58: x 138.5 -> 51.1; y 149.5 -> 148.8; z 308.7 -> 304.9).
  section_phase_modulation(vessel_mask: np.ndarray bool, tissue_mask: np.ndarray bool, axis: int, period_vox: float, n_bins: int = 15) -> dict{ratio, var_frac, waveform: [n_bins]}: per-plane density = vessel count / tissue count along axis; fold plane index mod period into n_bins; ratio = max/min of the bin means; var_frac = fraction of plane-to-plane variance explained by the folded waveform.
  Not done in v1.1 (P3 evidence): per-z-slice offsets, 2.82 mm tile modulation, vessel channel repair (3-D Frangi unsalvageable; per-section 2-D detection is future work).

2.4 Fine stage (octreg/fine.py), inserted after line 217 on T_final (=: T_start); runs only when a.fine == "on". Everything below is a function fine_stage(T_start, ctx, cfg, rng) -> (T_accepted, T_candidate, info).
  FineContext (dataclass, built in register.py): mri (mmap f32), mri_tissue (mmap bool), A_mri, lo, hi (region), oct150 (np f32), oct_mask (np bool), A_oct, c_o, BLOCK_R, VOX_M, VOX_O, ref015 (Refiner on [WM,GM], the structural gate), device.
  MRI box: bc = (T_start @ [c_o,1])[:3]; vlo/vhi = world_bbox_to_voxel(A_mri, mri.shape, bc - BOX, bc + BOX) clipped to lo/hi (the lines 189-195 pattern, factored into a local function used by both vascular and fine so behaviour with --fine off is unchanged); mri_box f32, tis_box bool, A_box.
  Per level L in cfg.levels (mm):
    f_o = max(1, round(L / VOX_O)); f_m = max(1, round(L / VOX_M)). OCT: I_o, A_o = avg_pool_iso(oct150, A_oct, f_o) (or the arrays themselves at f = 1); m_o = avg_pool(oct_mask) > 0.5; valid_o = avg_pool((oct150 > 0).float()) > 0.99, eroded by 1 voxel at L >= 0.3 and 2 voxels at L < 0.3 (torch max-pool of the complement). MRI: I_m, A_m = avg_pool_iso(mri_box, A_box, f_m); t_m = avg_pool(tis_box) > 0.5.
    Flattening (pose independent, each image in its own space, masked normalised convolution): F = I / (G_s(I*m) / (G_s(m) + 1e-6) + 1e-3 * mean(I[m])) - 1, s = cfg.flatten_mm / voxel (separable Gaussian, radius 3 s, zero padding; at L < 0.3 compute the low-pass on the grid pooled by 2 and trilinearly upsample); m = m_o & valid_o for OCT, t_m for MRI; then z-score inside m, clamp to [-4, 4], 0 outside m. Single channel each: F_o [1,d,h,w], F_m [1,D,H,W].
    Specimen mask at level start (fixed within the level): m_spec = (resample_to_grid(to_t(erode_ball(t_m, cfg.erode_mm))[None], to_t(A_m), to_t(A_o), shape_o, T_grid_to_vol=to_t(T_cur)) > 0.5)[0] & m_o & valid_o, where erode_ball(mask, r_mm) = (distance_transform_edt(mask) * vox >= r_mm) (scipy on CPU, cheap at these grids). I58 at 0.3 mm: 7.97 cm3 = 0.3 M points; 0.15 mm: ~2.4 M.
    Polarity guard at T_cur (raw z-scored intensities inside m_spec, not the flattened ones; P2: 26/37 raw vs 25/37 flattened): tile the bounding box of m_spec 4x4x4; for blocks with > 2000 * (0.3 / L)^3 voxels compute masked NCC(I_o z-scored, I_m sampled through T_cur, z-scored); frac_neg = fraction of blocks with NCC < 0; mean = volume-weighted mean. sign = -1 if frac_neg >= 0.60 and mean <= -0.05; +1 if frac_neg <= 0.40 and mean >= +0.05; else 0 ("mixed"). Logged per level. I58 at 0.3 mm expected: 26/37 = 0.70, mean -0.15 -> -1. DANDI (GM-bright OCT vs GM-bright MRI) -> +1; I55 (OCT WM-bright) -> -1 automatically.
    Similarity: sim = cfg.sim if not auto else ("ncc" if sign != 0 else "lcc2"). If sim in (ncc, lcc) and sign == 0: skip the level (info level.skipped = "mixed_polarity"), T_cur unchanged.
    class FineRefiner(Refiner) [sim = ncc, point-based, fast]: __init__(F_m, A_m, F_o, A_o, m_spec.float()[None], tis_m (float [1,D,H,W]), T_start (4x4), sign, device): super().__init__(sign * F_m, A_m, F_o, A_o, mask, device); self.T0 = to_t(T_start); self.TIS = tis_m.to(device). loss_of(self, D, subsample=1): pts = self.pts_o[::subsample]; w = self.w[::subsample]; fo = self.fo[:, ::subsample]; T = self.T0 @ D; pm = apply_affine(T, pts); fm = sample_at_world(self.FM, self.A_M, pm); tis = (sample_at_world(self.TIS, self.A_M, pm)[0] > 0.5).float().detach(); return 1 - masked_ncc(fm, fo, w * tis). refine_delta(self, dof, iters, lrs, clamp, reg) -> (T_full, loss): calls super().refine(np.eye(4), dof=dof, iters=iters, lr_rot, lr_t, lr_ls, lr_sh, subsample, ls_clamp=clamp, sh_clamp=clamp, reg=reg) and returns (T_start_np @ D_best, loss). Chaining levels: after each refine_delta set self.T0 = to_t(T_full) and continue from D = I (so the clamp is always relative to the CURRENT start of the step, and the cumulative ls/sh drift is bounded by clamp per step; log the cumulative log-scale change). evaluate_T(T) = 1 - loss at D = inv(T0) @ T.
    class FineDense [sim = lcc / lcc2, and the backward problem]: dense on the fixed grid: pts = grid_points(A_fix, shape_fix) (all voxels; memory: 11 M points x 3 at 0.15 mm = fine on the 4090); moving image + tissue sampled through T; masked local statistics with a separable box of w = round(cfg.lcc_mm / vox) | 1 voxels via three avg_pool3d passes (w,1,1), (1,w,1), (1,1,w), stride 1, padding w//2, count_include_pad=True: n = box(m), mu_a = box(a m)/n, var_a = box(a^2 m)/n - mu_a^2, cov = box(a b m)/n - mu_a mu_b, LCC = cov / sqrt(var_a var_b + 1e-2); loss = 1 - sign * mean over (m & n > 0.5) of LCC (lcc) or 1 - mean of cov^2 / (var_a var_b + 1e-2) (lcc2), m = m_spec & tissue(T) (detached). Own Adam loop that copies Refiner.refine's parametrisation (params_from_matrix(I, c_o) -> compose(r, t, ls, sh, c_o, mirror) with D about identity, cosine schedule, relative clamps, best-loss T kept). Inputs globally z-scored inside m_spec at the level start.
    Schedule: level 0.3: rigid 150 iters (lr_rot 0.01, lr_t 0.15) -> affine cfg.iters (lr_rot 0.01, lr_t 0.15, lr_ls 0.005, lr_sh 0.005), clamp cfg.clamp, reg cfg.reg. level 0.15: affine cfg.iters with all lrs halved. T_fine = result of the last level.
  Verification (all label-free; recorded in info regardless of acceptance):
    V1 restarts: cfg.n_restarts perturbations of T_start via compose from params_from_matrix(T_start, c_o): rotation U(2,6) deg about a random axis, translation U(-2,2) mm per axis, log-scale U(-0.03,0.03) per axis; each run through the full level schedule; converged iff transform_diff(Tr, T_fine, c_o)["corner_mean_mm"] < 0.3; also specimen-point displacement stats (mean/p95/max over 50k random m_spec points at the finest level) of each Tr vs T_fine.
    V2 multi-similarity: T_lcc = FineDense(sim = lcc if sign != 0 else lcc2) from T_start with the schedule (0.3: rigid 100 + affine 100; 0.15: affine 100); T_mi = scipy.optimize.minimize(method="Nelder-Mead") over 6 rigid params (rotvec about c_o in deg, t in mm) from T_fine maximising MI32 at 0.15 mm (32-bin joint histogram via torch.bincount of raw I_o vs raw I_m sampled through T inside m_spec & tissue(T); bin edges = 0.5-99.5 percentiles fixed at T_fine), initial simplex +-0.5 mm / +-1 deg, maxfev 300, xatol 0.05 mm. Report point_disp_stats for the pairs (fine, lcc), (fine, mi), (lcc, mi).
    V3 split-half: at 0.15 mm, for each OCT array axis split m_spec at the median coordinate of its voxels -> two halves; FineRefiner with the half as mask, affine 100 iters from T_fine; per axis: point_disp_stats between the two half solutions over the full m_spec points (mean_mm); loho_max_mm = max over axes.
    V4 landscapes at T_fine (finest level; no gradient): the fine loss (sign-corrected, higher = better) along the 3 OCT array axes (+-0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 mm), rotations about them through c_o (+-1, 2, 5 deg) AND log-scale along them (+-3 %, +-6 %; the stage optimises affine and P2 never swept scale): for each axis argmax offset (parabolic fit through the 3 points around the max) and unimodal = no interior local maximum other than the peak. Also MI32 on the same 9 axes.
    V5 inverse consistency (--fine-verify full only): FineDense with roles swapped (fixed = MRI level grid with mask erode_ball(t_m, 1.3 mm) & (oct_mask sampled through inv(T_start) > 0.5), moving = F_o with validity valid_o sampled through the backward transform, sign the same), started at inv(T_start), same schedule -> T_bwd (MRI -> OCT). ICE = |T_fine p - inv(T_bwd) p| over the 50k specimen points: mean, p95.
    Structural gate: struct_ncc_before = 1 - ctx.ref015.evaluate(T_start); struct_ncc_after = 1 - ctx.ref015.evaluate(T_fine).
  ACCEPTANCE GATE (all must hold, else T_accepted = T_start, accepted = false, reasons listed):
    (a) fine loss at T_fine <= loss at T_start - 0.002 (finest level, same m_spec, same sim);
    (b) struct_ncc_after >= struct_ncc_before - 0.02;
    (c) transform_diff(T_fine, T_start, c_o)["corner_mean_mm"] <= cfg.max_move (3.0); flag fine_large_move if > 1.5;
    (d) V1: >= 5 of 8 restarts converged;
    (e) MI32(T_fine) >= MI32(T_start) - 0.001 (sign-free witness that the flip did not exploit an artefact);
    (f) the finest executed level was not skipped for mixed polarity, or sim lcc2 was used (recorded).
  Uncertainty number: U_mm = max(p95 of the specimen-point displacement of the converged restarts vs T_fine, max pairwise mean displacement in V2, loho_max_mm). The sub-millimetre self-consistency claim requires accepted == true and U_mm < 1.0 (target <= 0.5); the accuracy statement needs the PI's landmark pairs (open question 1).
  Outputs (register.py): np.save(out/"T_oct2mri_prefine.npy", T_start) before the stage; np.save(out/"T_oct2mri_fine_candidate.npy", T_fine) always; T_final = T_accepted; T_oct2mri.npy = T_final (existing consumers unchanged). log["fine"] = {mode, sim_per_level, sign_per_level, guard: [{level, frac_neg, mean, n_blocks}], levels: [{level, sim, loss_before, loss_after, moved_mm, skipped}], struct_ncc_before, struct_ncc_after, mi_before, mi_after, vs_start: transform_diff, stretch_ijk_before, stretch_ijk_after, cum_log_scale, restarts: {n, n_converged, detail, p95_disp_converged_mm}, multi_sim: {fine_lcc, fine_mi, lcc_mi (each mean/p95/max mm)}, split_half: {per_axis_mm, loho_max_mm}, landscape: {fine: {per_axis: {argmax_offset, unimodal}}, mi: {...}}, ice: {mean_mm, p95_mm} | None, U_mm, accepted, reasons, seconds}. log["prep_summary"] = {mask_mode, destripe_applied, V_oct_mask_cm3, V_mri_tissue_cm3, vessel_section_modulation} from prep.json (None when absent). Warning at line 113 when V_o > 1.5 V_m and mask_mode in (None, "intensity"): "OCT mask over-inclusive: re-prep with --oct-mask auto/texture". Summary print (lines 269-271) gains fine_accepted, fine_moved_mm, U_mm, vascular_accepted. scripts/summarize.py (owner B) gains columns vasc_accepted, fine_accepted, fine_moved_mm, U_mm, ice_mm, fine_restarts, mask_mode, destripe; tolerates search top1/top2 None.

======================================================================
3. QC AND REGRESSION TOOLING (owner C)
======================================================================
3.1 scripts/viz_result.py: octv_vessels.npy optional (skip the green contours and the density when absent); when run/T_oct2mri_prefine.npy exists add a third MRI column "prefine" (Ts = {structural, prefine, final}); nothing else changes.
3.2 scripts/qc_fine.py --work W --run R [--T PATH] [--out DIR] (intensity-independent and sign-free acceptance metrics; reads only prep outputs and run outputs; no import from fine.py):
  Q1 boundary agreement: B_o = boundary voxels of oct150_mask (mask & ~erosion by 1 voxel), excluding voxels within 2 voxels of a box face or of the invalid region (oct150 > 0 eroded 2) and whose mapped position (through T) lies < 1 mm inside the MRI FOV edge; d = EDT of the MRI tissue boundary (mri_tissue & ~erosion 1 voxel, distance_transform_edt with sampling = MRI voxel mm) sampled trilinearly at the mapped points -> median / p75 / p90 overall and per face class (outward normal = -gradient of the Gaussian-smoothed (sigma 2 vox) mask, classed by dominant array axis and sign; the rim-less deep-end face (large z) is reported separately). Reverse: MRI tissue boundary voxels inside the OCT box (through inv T) -> EDT of the OCT mask boundary. Same numbers for the prefine pose when T_oct2mri_prefine.npy exists.
  Q2 MI32 landscape at the given T on the 0.15 mm level (raw oct150 vs raw MRI sampled through T inside m_spec = (erode_ball(mri_tissue, 1.3 mm) through T > 0.5) & oct150_mask & (oct150 > 0 eroded 2); bins from the 0.5-99.5 percentiles at T): 3 translations (+-0.25/0.5/1/2 mm along OCT array axes), 3 rotations (+-1/2/5 deg through c_o), 3 log-scales (+-3/6 %): argmax offsets (parabolic), unimodality.
  Q3 figures: qc_fine.png = 5 OCT planes (depth 0.2/0.35/0.5/0.65/0.8) x {OCT, MRI via T, checkerboard with 6-voxel (0.9 mm) checks, edge overlay (Canny of the MRI resampled into OCT space over the OCT)} with the MRI tissue boundary contour (prefine dashed, final solid) and the OCT mask contour; qc_fine_landscape.png = Q2 profiles.
  Writes qc_fine.json {boundary: {...}, mi_landscape: {...}, T_used} into the run dir (or --out).
3.3 scripts/regress.py REF_RUN NEW_RUN [--tol default] : compares result.json (and prep.json of the two --work dirs read from args.work) against the tolerance table in section 5.3; prints one pass/fail row per criterion; exit 1 on any failure.
3.4 scripts/test_destripe.py --work W --out DIR: runs detect_stripe_axis and destripe_inplace on a COPY of W/octv.npy in DIR (never writes into W), prints before/after profile stds, FFT peak, zero fraction, min/max, writes before/after PNG (mid z-x and x-y planes, x-profile).

======================================================================
4. AUTOMATIC FALLBACKS (summary)
======================================================================
F1 mask: auto -> intensity unless V_int > 1.5 V_mri; texture rejected (band 0.5-1.75 x V_mri) -> intensity + reason. V_mri unknown -> intensity + warning.
F2 destripe: axis not decisive (min NCC >= 0.8 x second) -> skipped + reason; k150 % kv != 0 -> hard error (explicit).
F3 vascular: modulation ratio > 1.6 -> skipped; gate failed -> T_struct kept, accepted=false.
F4 fine: mixed polarity -> lcc2 (auto) or level skipped (ncc/lcc forced); any gate item failed -> T_start kept, candidate saved, accepted=false; no level executed -> accepted=false reason "no_level".
F5 register: missing prep.json keys (legacy prep) -> v1 behaviour everywhere.

open_questions:
1. Accuracy vs precision: every I58 number in this spec is label-free self-consistency (restarts, multi-similarity, split-half, inverse consistency, boundary agreement). Rotation about the block axes is undetermined at +-3 deg by every measure at 0.3 mm (P2), i.e. up to ~0.5 mm at the specimen periphery. Only landmark pairs from the PI (~20 corresponding points, HANDOFF Q3) can turn U into a TRE — request them now, in parallel with implementation.
2. Sectioning axis: P3 infers from the data (sawtooth with 15.0-slice period, adjacent-plane decorrelation, FOV stepping) that OCT array axis 2 (x) is the physical sectioning axis and axes 0/1 are en-face, the opposite of the v1 working assumption. The destripe is axis-agnostic with a data-driven guard, but the slab normalisation still runs along axis 0 (left as is: measured harmless on I58, and changing it breaks zero-diff on DANDI). Confirm with Xiangrui's acquisition metadata before this goes into the paper; a v1.2 item is to move oct_slab_normalize to the detected axis.
3. Largest-connected-component rule: the mask keeps only the largest component (P1-validated at 18.05 cm3), so the separate small tissue piece present in the MRI is dropped from the OCT template; n_cc before the filter is recorded. Decide whether v1.2 keeps components >= 5 % of the largest (affects the structural template mass only).
4. Mask excess (1.36x MRI tissue) remains: the striped comb band under the ventral surface and deep-end tile pockets stay in the mask; the fine stage is immune (m_spec is eroded MRI tissue through T), the structural Otsu split is slightly biased. P1 caveat 7 (second-pass markers from MRI tissue via T) is not implemented. Also the 13.3 cm3 target is itself uncertain because the MRI crop covers 73 % of the OCT box.
5. Polarity is not universal (30 % of ~7 mm sub-blocks correlate positively on I58); the global sign flip is a compromise. The 0.15 mm level was never landscape-probed (P2 was at 0.3 mm). If the 0.15 mm guard says mixed, the auto path uses lcc2 (contrast 0.25-0.31, +0.6-0.9 mm depth bias in P2) — F3/F7 then decide.
6. The vascular gate default (--vascular-min-ncc 0.02) is 4x above I58's 0.0055 and 15x below I46's 0.296; I55's recorded vessel-channel NCC must be read from work/runs/I55_otsu/result.json before R9. P1 vs P2 contradiction on the residual (P1 reads >= 3-5 mm deep-end misplacement of MRI tissue mapped through T; P2 reads <= 1 mm): F7 (boundary agreement per face class, intensity-independent) is the arbiter.
